freeze_order: Teacher phrases for ranks 101-200 were authored and committed before any evaluation query for those ranks existed.
The 100 evaluation queries were then authored and committed without consulting retrieval output.
Retrieval evaluation may only begin after both artifacts are frozen.
reporting: hits/N + percentage + 95% Wilson interval + evidence class
review_policy: Raw result is immutable. Review every teacher-fusion miss and regression plus a deterministic 15-case sample of nominal hits against canonical taxonomy evidence.
known_limitation: Teacher enrichment is available for ranks 1-200 during this stage but not yet for ranks 201-316, so this is not a fully teacher-covered production-universe validation. A subsequent gate should freeze teacher language for all P80 concepts before testing another untouched rank block.
same_model_bias: The same GPT-5.6 Sol system authored teacher language and later evaluation descriptions. Artifact ordering prevents direct miss-driven tuning but does not remove shared linguistic priors.
